name: zcode-tps-monitor
description: Token output-rate monitor for ZCode: shows real instant tokens/sec (from the ZCode usage DB) for the current question at the end of each tool-using reply — never the previous turn — plus a /tps command, MCP tools, and a real-time dashboard; also supports service-TPS monitoring via a configurable metrics URL or demo data.

description_i18n.en: Token rate monitor: per-question instant tokens/sec from the ZCode usage DB, shown at the end of each tool-using reply; /tps command, MCP tools, and a real-time dashboard. Supports a real metrics URL or built-in demo data for service TPS.
description_i18n.zh-CN: ZCode Token 输出速率监控：每条调用了工具的回答末尾自动附本问的即时 tok/s（读取 ZCode usage 数据库，绝不显示上一轮），另有 /tps 命令、MCP 工具与实时大屏；同时支持业务 TPS 监控（可配置指标接口或演示数据）。

metrics_url.title: Metrics URL
metrics_url.description: HTTP 接口地址，返回包含 tps/qps 字段的 JSON；留空则使用演示数据。
